name: gardenlinux-dashboard
description: Garden Linux Daily Dashboard - Pipeline status and package monitoring

scripts.packages: git fetch origin && git checkout origin/packages packages && git restore --staged packages
scripts.historic: git fetch origin && git checkout origin/historic-releases historic && git restore --staged historic
scripts.serve: npm run packages && npm run historic && python3 -m http.server 8000
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js; npm run lint:format

author: Garden Linux Team
